description.zh: 输入URL，当输入类型是RTMP-PULL/SRT-Listener时可以修改
description.en: The source URL. You can modify this parameter only when the source type is RTMP-PULL or SRT-Listener.

description.zh: 输入名称，只有该实例开启输入主备时才需要填写
description.en: Input name. This parameter is required only when primary/standby input is enabled for the instance.

description.zh: SRT延迟，当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时可以修改
description.en: The latency for the SRT stream. You can modify this parameter only when the source type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller.

description.zh: SRT加密密钥，当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时可以修改
description.en: The SRT key. You can modify this parameter only when the source type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller.

description.zh: SRT加密长度，当输入类型是SRT-Listener/SRT-Caller时可以修改
description.en: The encryption key length. You can modify this parameter only when the source type is SRT-Listener or SRT-Caller.

descriptions.zh:
- 只有Flow实例状态为offline时才可以修改输入。
- 无法修改输入类型。
descriptions.en:
- The input can only be modified when the Flow instance status is offline.

- The input type cannot be modified.
